work.name: rtCamp
highlights: Consolidated a multi-subsite CMS into a single scalable platform, redesigning content architecture, metadata handling, and reusable workflows across properties.

Delivered CMS enhancements across REST APIs, CLI utilities, scheduled automation, database schema extensions, import workflows, debugging, testing, and admin/frontend interfaces.

Delivered a mentor-led Spring Boot session on short notice to candidates across the country, ensuring uninterrupted learning.
